one_line: A Kushan merchant-administrator overseeing luxury goods at Begram (Kapisa), where Silk Road caravans met Indian Ocean trade.

appearance.age_look: late 30s, medium height, sturdy build with the calm posture of a seasoned administrator
appearance.face: oval face, medium wheat complexion, straight nose, full but neat beard and moustache, slightly arched brows, focused almond-shaped eyes, default expression a composed, assessing gaze with a hint of shonen-style determination
appearance.hair: thick, straight dark brown hair to just above the shoulders, center-parted and smoothly combed back, ending in a subtle outward flip; a soft conical Kushan-style cap of felted wool in muted maroon sits snugly on the crown, leaving the hair visible around the sides
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length Kushan tunic (quasi-kaftan) of undyed warm-beige wool, slightly fitted at the waist and closed on the right side with a wrap overlap, edged with a narrow dark red-brown border; over this, a sleeveless, hip-length dark indigo wool vest with simple vertical quilting gives a structured look; a woven wool sash in deep rust red is wrapped firmly around his waist and knotted on the left, its loose end hanging to mid-thigh; his trousers are straight, slightly loose, ankle-length, in soft olive green cotton or wool twill, tucked into mid-calf light brown leather boots with a rounded toe; the outfit is modest and practical, with subtle decorative trim only at the tunic edges and sash, evoking Kushan-era Central Asian-Indian tailoring rather than fantasy armor; a simple narrow bronze bangle on his right wrist and a short chain necklace with a small, flat carnelian bead are his only jewellery, suggesting quiet prosperity.
appearance.signature: A sturdy, rectangular wooden inventory tablet with carved border, held in his left hand, its surface scored with shallow lines like a writing board; in his right hand, a slender stylus of bronze or wood, poised as if marking goods from distant Rome, Egypt, India, and Han China within a debated Begram warehouse or gift-store context.

ref_desc: A Kushan trade overseer with oval wheat-toned face, shoulder-length dark brown hair under a maroon cap, beige wrap tunic, dark indigo vest, rust sash, olive trousers, brown boots, bronze-carnelian jewellery, and a wooden inventory tablet with stylus in hand.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model of a Kushan trade overseer from Begram/Kapisa: an adult man with an oval wheat-toned face, neat full beard, straight nose, determined almond eyes, and shoulder-length dark brown hair center-parted and combed back under a snug maroon conical cap. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length warm-beige wool wrap tunic with a right-side overlap and narrow dark red-brown edging, overlaid by a hip-length dark indigo quilted vest. A deep rust red woven sash is wrapped tightly around his waist and knotted on the left, with its end hanging to mid-thigh. His straight olive green trousers tuck into mid-calf light brown leather boots with rounded toes. Add a simple bronze bangle on his right wrist and a short chain necklace with a small flat carnelian bead. In his left hand he carries a rectangular wooden inventory tablet with a carved border and scored surface, while his right hand holds a slender bronze or wooden stylus, posed as a calm, focused administrator of Kapisa’s mixed warehouse and gift-store goods. Show him standing in a neutral pose that clearly reveals his face, hair, full costume, boots, and the tablet and stylus, using a palette dominated by warm beige, dark indigo, rust red, olive green, and light brown.
